goalZh: 会用 be going to 根据迹象说“要下雪了”,听懂停课的消息
canDoZh: 能根据天气预报和眼前的迹象说“要下雪了”,听懂学校因下雪停课的通知

newItems.noteZh: 完整说法是 weather forecast;重音在前 FOR-cast;Look at the forecast.(看看天气预报。)
sk 之间不加元音;Look at the sky.(看看天。)天阴得发灰可以说 The sky is gray.。
美式拼一个 l(英式 cancelled);Classes are canceled.(课取消了。)词尾 -ed 读 /d/。
美国学校因为下雪停课的那一天叫 snow day,学生都很开心;复合词重音在前:SNOW day。
人感到兴奋说 I'm excited.,不说 I'm exciting(那是“我这个人让人兴奋”);t 在两个元音之间美式读闪音。
ui 读短音 /ɪ/;过去式 built /bɪlt/;build a snowman(堆雪人)。
snow + man,重音在前;复数 snowmen。
build 的名词;宿舍楼、教学楼都可以叫 building:in front of our building(在我们楼前)。
a 读 /æ/,嘴张大;“在校园里”说 on campus,用 on。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Lei! Look at the forecast. Snow tomorrow!
lines.zh: (傍晚,艾米发来消息)磊!你看天气预报,明天下雪!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Snow? It doesn't snow a lot in Seattle.
lines.zh: 下雪?西雅图不常下雪啊。

lines.speaker: amy
lines.text: Not a lot. But look at the sky!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Oh, it's really gray. It's going to snow!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Lei, wake up! Look outside! The campus is all white!
lines.zh: (第二天一早)磊,醒醒!快看外面!校园全白了!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: And morning classes are canceled. It's a snow day!
lines.zh: 而且上午的课取消了,今天下雪停课!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Really? I can't wait to go outside!
lines.zh: 真的?我等不及要出去了!

lines.speaker: ethan
lines.text: Me too! It never snows in LA. I'm so excited!
lines.zh: 我也是!洛杉矶从来不下雪。我太兴奋了!

lines.speaker: lei
lines.text: Let's build a snowman in front of our building!
lines.zh: 我们在楼前堆个雪人吧!

lines.speaker: sofia
lines.text: A snowman? I'm coming! It's my first snow!
lines.zh: (磊打电话叫上索菲亚)堆雪人?我马上来!这是我第一次见到雪!

questions.prompt: 艾米为什么觉得明天要下雪?
options: 天气预报说的,天看起来也要下雪
questions.explainZh: Look at the forecast. Snow tomorrow! …… But look at the sky!(天气预报说明天下雪,天色也像要下雪。)

questions.prompt: 第二天早上学校通知了什么?
questions.explainZh: 伊森说 And morning classes are canceled. It's a snow day!(上午的课取消了。)
It never snows in LA. I'm so excited!(洛杉矶从来不下雪,所以他特别兴奋。)

grammar.titleZh: be going to 表示“看样子要……”
grammar.bodyZh: 第 7 单元学过用 be going to 说计划(I'm going to go hiking.)。它还有一个用法:根据眼前的迹象,预测马上要发生的事。Look at the sky. It's going to snow.(看这天,要下雪了。)中文常说“要……了”“看样子会……”,英语就用 be going to + 动词原形。看天气预报、看手机上的预测也常这么说:It's going to rain tomorrow.。be 不能漏:不说 It going to snow.。

examples.text: Look at the sky. It's going to snow!
It's going to stop this evening.
Is it going to rain all day?

grammar.titleZh: canceled 作形容词:Classes are canceled.
grammar.bodyZh: canceled(取消了的)放在 be 动词后面,说某件事被取消了:Classes are canceled.(课取消了。)Morning classes are canceled.(上午的课取消了。)美国学校因为下雪停课,那一天叫 a snow day。美式拼写 canceled 只有一个 l(英式是 cancelled),读 /ˈkænsəld/,词尾 -ed 读 /d/。

examples.text: Morning classes are canceled. It's a snow day!
examples.zh: 上午的课取消了。下雪停课啦!
